records.title: Security Incident Update #2 (2026-10-30)
records.summary: Binance states an approximately $6.3B incident impact, more than $6.34B company funds set aside, $5B held in exact affected token assets, remaining relevant token assets being acquired through market/OTC channels, approximately $3B frozen on-chain, and a post-incident PoR update targeted by Nov 2.
records.limitations: Company statement; no independent audit or token-level XRP allocation. The stated 34-hour withdrawal restoration target is conditional on security checks.

records.title: Binance sets aside over $6.34 billion to cover losses from attack
records.summary: Reuters reports Binance's $6.34B reserve statement, $5B already held in affected token assets and approximately $3B frozen with partner assistance.
records.limitations: The reserve and freeze amounts originate from Binance/company and partner statements; Reuters does not independently verify XRP-specific purchases.

records.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
records.summary: CoinDesk reports additional breach points, an EIP-7702 account-delegation pathway, an evidence-erasure mechanism, a Sunday withdrawal-restoration target and a planned Proof of Reserves update.
records.limitations: Technical sequence remains subject to Binance's ongoing investigation; no full public postmortem was available at cutoff.
